name: Morse.Homology.TopTriple
difference: This is a representation difference only. The project's structure has an extra field k : Z ⟶ X together with fac : i ≫ j = k (so that the pair (X, Z) can be chosen definitionally), and the blind structure has no such field. Because k is determined by fac, the two types are equivalent.
why: An explicit equivalence TopTriple ≃ T forgets k; its inverse sets k := incZY ≫ incYX with fac := rfl, and left_inv follows by subst fac. The equivalence preserves pairXY and pairYZ by rfl and pairXZ by fac. Both encode Z ⊆ Y ⊆ X as composable embeddings in TopCat.
